form.label: Backend agent
form.description: Run the Finding Evidence Agent in the backend: execute evidence searches, apply built-in and custom judges, persist scores. Enable the modular input under Settings → Data inputs for a scheduled cycle.

ol.li: gather_evidence — run the top recommended SPL searches on this search head.
score — run every enabled judge in judges.conf (builtin, rule, and custom Python).
persist / emit — write KV store + index events (fea:agent:result).

div.p: Add a custom judge: drop local/judges/my_judge.py with a judge() function, or add a stanza to local/judges.conf. See judges/README.md.
Scheduled backend: Settings → Data inputs → Finding Evidence Agent → enable the default input (disabled out of the box).

search.query: | findingagent mode=$mode$ run_searches=$run_searches$ limit=$limit$ | stats count(eval(investigation_required="Yes")) as count
| findingagent mode=$mode$ run_searches=$run_searches$ limit=$limit$ | stats sum(executed_search_count) as count

| findingagent mode=$mode$ run_searches=$run_searches$ limit=$limit$ | sort - followup_score | table followup_score, investigation_required, override_applied, finding_id, title, urgency, triage_disposition, executed_search_count, evidence_net_weight, agent_tasks

| findingagent mode=$mode$ run_searches=$run_searches$ limit=$limit$ | spath input=judges_json path={} output=j | mvexpand j | eval name=spath(j,"name"), decision=spath(j,"decision"), score=spath(j,"score"), mode=spath(j,"mode"), abstain=spath(j,"abstain"), rationale=spath(j,"rationale") | table finding_id, name, mode, score, decision, abstain, rationale
